author: Retro Game Corps
description:
ARMSX2 is a new PS2 emulator on Android that is derived from PCSX2, and it has a bright future ahead of it. It's become my preferred emulator app over the old standbys like AetherSX2 and NetherSX2 - here is my guide on how to get it up and running, with some play testing too.

Find it here: https://armsx2.net/
BIOS extraction: https://youtu.be/j6LQhX9Vjyg

Recommended Snapdragon devices:
Retroid Pocket 5: https://youtu.be/ZFTrwWQOe5Y
RP Flip 2: https://youtu.be/6LIZWnD-62Q
